buffer.scope: CPU-side launcher source texture, not full DDR or BOSIO reset

notes: Trace includes its own logging overhead and scheduler time.
Per-byte loop uses REMU, LBU, SB and pointer/size loads; no floating point in the observed background fill loop.
Divider RTL is bounded 32-step; remainder latency alone is not a demonstrated explanation of total elapsed time.
The initial programming command configured the FPGA, but its status query property name was wrong. A corrected read-only query verified DONE=1 and CRC_ERROR=0 without reprogramming.
